summary: Tested Organizations List Page UI fix (text colors) and password change functionality for Super Admin panel. Found and fixed critical bug where password reset endpoint was saving to wrong field name. All features now working correctly.

critical.issue: Password was being saved to 'hashed_password' field but login reads from 'password_hash' field - field name mismatch

working_correctly: Organizations List Page - text colors now white/slate-300 on dark background (readable)
Organizations List Page - Table headers visible (Organización, Estado, Plan, Uso, Miembros, Creado, Acciones)
Organizations List Page - Key icon button for password change in each row's Actions column
Password Change Modal - Opens from Organizations List
Password Change Modal - 'Toda la Org' option (all org users)
Password Change Modal - 'Usuario Individual' option (single user)
Password Change Modal - 'Generar' button generates 12-char random password
Organization Detail Page - Members tab shows member list
Organization Detail Page - 'Cambiar Contraseña (Todos)' button visible when members exist
Organization Detail Page - Individual Key icon for each member
Individual Password Change Modal in Members tab
Backend: /api/super-admin/users/{user_id}/reset-password - now correctly updates password_hash field
Password change flow works end-to-end (change → login with new → restore)

bugs_fixed.issue: Password reset endpoint saved password to wrong field ('hashed_password' instead of 'password_hash')
bugs_fixed.fix: Changed $set field from 'hashed_password' to 'password_hash' to match login endpoint

seed_data_creation: Created test membership for company_3ab116c0994d to verify Members tab functionality
context_for_next_testing_agent: Password reset functionality fully working. Organizations page UI colors fixed. Membership was created for testing purposes - company_3ab116c0994d now has 1 member.
